title: Wired
summary: Overhead wires slice the sky between recently built condos towers in Downtown Toronto: 252 Church at left, and Social at Church and Dundas, each having non-standard exteriors. While 252 Church's windows are offset every couple of floors, Social's balconies sport peaks and valleys like waves (an effective design from this vantage point, but lost as you move away from the building). Both non-standard exteriors act as if the power surging through the wires may be affecting them, each reacting differently, each adding to variety on the local skyline.
